summary.text: Kevin McCabe, a Republican, has served in the Alaska House of Representatives since 2021, according to the Alaska Legislature.

paragraphs.text: The legislative biography says McCabe was born in Hibbing, Minnesota, and served in the U.S. Coast Guard from 1976 to 1996, and that McCabe is a Boeing 747 captain with Atlas Air.

The biography lists a B.S. from Embry-Riddle and an MBA from Regis University, past work as chief pilot for Island Air Service in Kodiak and Alaska Air Taxi, and service as a volunteer firefighter in Kodiak.
